marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind west 10 to 15 knots becoming light near noon then becoming
south 10 to 15 Thursday afternoon. Wind becoming light Thursday
evening. Snow beginning near noon changing to scattered flurries
this evening and ending overnight. Scattered flurries Thursday evening. Fog
banks forming after midnight and dissipating Thursday afternoon. Visibility as
low as 1 mile in snow and 1 mile or less in fog banks. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>

marine.text: Over open water seas 1 metre or less.<br/>
